title: Causal circuit tracing reveals distinct computational architectures in single-cell foundation models: inhibitory dominance, biological coherence, and cross-model convergence.
one_liner_zh: 该文用稀疏自编码器追踪单细胞基础模型内部因果回路，虽涉及TF-靶基因调控边预测，但核心是模型内部特征互作而非TF-DNA结合机制，方法可迁移但非直接聚焦。
abstract: MOTIVATION: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose foundation-model activations into interpretable features, but the model-internal causal interactions between those features (i.e. what ablating one feature does to the others, as distinct from the biological causal structure of the underlying cells)-and how those model-internal relationships relate to biological structure-are uncharacterized in single-cell foundation models. RESULTS: We introduce model-internal causal circuit tracing-zeroing one SAE feature at a source layer and measuring the resulting change in all downstream SAE features, for each of 120 source features-and apply it to Geneformer V2-316M and scGPT whole-human across four conditions (96 892 ablation-derived edges, 80 191 forward passes). On annotation-selected source features, edges share GO/KEGG/Reactome/STRING/TRRUST ontology terms at 50.9%-68.5%, a 2.9-6.2x enrichment over a configuration-preserving permutation null (P<.002); on 20 randomly sampled source features this attenuates to 21.5%-26.3%-still 2.5-3.1x above null-quantifying the annotation-selection contribution. Inhibitory dominance (fraction of ablation edges with d<0, i.e. source activation supports downstream target) is 65.5%-89.4%. scGPT produces larger raw per-edge effects (mean |d|=1.40 versus 1.05); after feature-share normalization, Geneformer is stronger (paired gene-pair ratio 0.64 on 33 301 shared pairs). Cross-model consensus yields 1142 architecture-invariant domain pairs (ordered pairs of GO biological-process categories "A-->B" each connected by at least one ablation edge in both models; 10.6x enrichment over permutation null; P<.001). Circuit edge magnitude explains <1% of the variance in marginal driver-gene coexpression on the same cells (R2=0.010, n=31 176): the graph encodes structure beyond bivariate correlation. Against a matched-cell-type ENCODE ChIP-seq prior, circuit-predicted transcription factor (TF)-->target pairs are enriched 2.06x (Fisher OR 5.84), markedly higher than 1.12x against TRRUST; direct ChIP-seq-supported target pairs show 10-30x larger CRISPRi sign-bias-corrected excess than indirect pairs. Gene-level CRISPRi validation on Replogle K562 and the noncancer RPE1 arm (and a true primary-T-cell control from Shifrut E, Carnevale J, Tobin V et al. Genome-wide CRISPR screens in primary human T cells reveal key regulators of immune function. Cell 2018; 175: 1958-71.e15) after sign-bias correction shows excess over baseline of +0.03 and +0.35 percentage points on K562 and RPE1, respectively (baseline already 52%-56% from sign marginals); effect-magnitude Spearman correlations rho approximately 0. Bootstrap and per-cell-type stability (Nin50,100,200; B cell, CD4 + T, macrophage) give Pearson r>/=0.97 on shared edges with 100% sign agreement; edge Jaccard grows monotonically with sample size. The circuit graph is therefore highly reproducible as an effect-size map, cell type specific in edge identity, consistent with coexpression encoding, and weakly but detectably enriched for ChIP-seq-supported direct regulatory edges. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: https://github.com/Biodyn-AI/bio-sae-circuits (Python). Archival DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19,633,166 (Zenodo).
abstract_zh: 动机：稀疏自编码器（SAEs）将基础模型激活分解为可解释特征，但这些特征之间模型内部的因果交互（即消融一个特征对其他特征的影响，区别于底层细胞的生物因果结构）——以及这些模型内部关系如何与生物结构相关联——在单细胞基础模型中尚未被表征。结果：我们引入了模型内部因果回路追踪——在源层将120个源特征中的每一个SAE特征置零，并测量所有下游SAE特征的变化——并将其应用于Geneformer V2-316M和scGPT全人类数据，涵盖四种条件（96,892条消融衍生边，80,191次前向传播）。在注释选择的源特征上，边共享GO/KEGG/Reactome/STRING/TRRUST本体论术语的比例为50.9%-68.5%，相对于配置保持的置换零模型富集2.9-6.2倍（P<.002）；在20个随机采样的源特征上，这一比例衰减至21.5%-26.3%——仍高于零模型2.5-3.1倍——从而量化了注释选择的贡献。抑制性主导（消融边中d<0的比例，即源激活支持下游目标）为65.5%-89.4%。scGPT产生更大的原始每边效应（平均|d|=1.40对比1.05）；在特征共享归一化后，Geneformer更强（在33,301个共享基因对上的配对基因对比率为0.64）。跨模型共识产生1,142个架构不变域对（GO生物过程类别“A-->B”的有序对，每个对在两种模型中至少由一条消融边连接；相对于置换零模型富集10.6倍；P<.001）。回路边幅度解释了同一细胞上边缘驱动基因共表达方差的小于1%（R2=0.010，n=31,176）：该图编码了超越双变量相关性的结构。相对于匹配细胞类型的ENCODE ChIP-seq先验，回路预测的转录因子（TF）-->目标对富集2.06倍（Fisher OR 5.84），显著高于相对于TRRUST的1.12倍；直接ChIP-seq支持的目标对显示比间接对大10-30倍的CRISPRi符号偏差校正超额。在Replogle K562和非癌性RPE1臂（以及来自Shifrut E, Carnevale J, Tobin V等人的真实原代T细胞对照，Genome-wide CRISPR screens in primary human T cells reveal key regulators of immune function. Cell 2018; 175: 1958-71.e15）上的基因水平CRISPRi验证，在符号偏差校正后，K562和RPE1的超额分别比基线高+0.03和+0.35个百分点（基线已从符号边际为52%-56%）；效应幅度Spearman相关性rho约0。Bootstrap和每细胞类型稳定性（Nin50,100,200；B细胞、CD4 + T、巨噬细胞）在共享边上给出Pearson r>/=0.97，符号一致性100%；边Jaccard随样本量单调增长。因此，回路图作为效应大小图高度可重复，在边身份上具有细胞类型特异性，与共表达编码一致，并且对ChIP-seq支持的直接调控边有弱但可检测的富集。可用性和实现：https://github.com/Biodyn-AI/bio-sae-circuits (Python)。存档DOI：10.5281/zenodo.19,633,166 (Zenodo)。
